headline: Dadelo expects to reach PLN 1 billion in revenue and start operations in the Czech Republic in 2027
summary: Dadelo expects about PLN 700 million revenue in 2026 and PLN 1 billion in 2027, CEO Ryszard Zawieruszyński said. It plans to open stationary and online operations in the Czech Republic in 2027, without ruling out acquisitions.
why: Dadelo is a Polish retail company, and such revenue and expansion targets indicate its growth strategy. Investors watch whether companies meet forward revenue guidance and foreign expansion plans.
